৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).question: ১) Which of the following best defines marketing according to Kotler?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).exp:
Explanation: Kotler defines marketing as “the process by which companies create value for customers and build strong relationships in order to capture value from customers in return” (Kotler et al., 2022, p. 29). It is broader than selling (A) and includes value delivery, not just operational efficiency (C) or packaging (D).
References: Kotler, P. et al. (2022)

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).question: ২) Which is a core concept of marketing?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).exp:
Core concepts include needs (basic human requirements), wants (shaped by culture and personality), and demands (wants backed by purchasing power). Options A, C, and D are important factors but not foundational concepts.
References: Kotler et al. (2022), Ch. 1, p. 32.

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).question: ৩) Which statement aligns with the production concept?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).option1: “Build it better, and they will buy.”
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).option2: “Focus on efficiency and low costs to make products affordable.”
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).exp:
The production concept emphasizes efficiency and mass production to keep costs low. Option A is the product concept, C reflects the marketing concept, and D is a marketing/customer concept principle.
References: Kotler et al. (2022), Ch. 1, p. 35.

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).question: ৪) Which orientation risks marketing myopia most?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).exp:
Explanation: Marketing myopia occurs when firms focus excessively on product features rather than customer benefits. The product concept is most prone to this (Levitt, 1960). Production focus (A) risks ignoring customer needs differently; marketing (C) and societal marketing (D) emphasize needs and welfare.
References: Kotler et al. (2022), Ch. 1, pp. 36–37.

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).question: ৫) A soft drink company aggressively pushes stock through promotions without first researching customer preferences. This shows:
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).exp:
The selling concept emphasizes aggressive promotion to achieve sales, assuming customers need persuasion. Marketing concept (D) is research-driven; societal (A) adds welfare; product concept (C) emphasizes quality/features.
References: Kotler et al. (2022), Ch. 1, p. 37.

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).question: ৬) “The key to achieving organizational goals is knowing the needs and wants of target markets and delivering the desired satisfactions better than competitors.” This is:
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).exp:
This is Kotler’s formal definition of the marketing concept, which focuses on meeting customer needs first. Production, product, and selling concepts are company-centric rather than customer-centric.
References: Kotler et al. (2022), Ch. 1, p. 37.

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).question: ৭) Which orientation adds society’s long-term interests to the marketing concept?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).exp:
The societal marketing concept balances company profits, consumer satisfaction, and societal well-being. It goes beyond the marketing concept by adding a third dimension.
References: Kotler et al. (2022), Ch. 1, p. 38

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).question: ৮)  Which is NOT part of the marketing process?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).exp:
While efficiency supports marketing, maximizing factory utilization is an operational goal, not part of Kotler’s 5-step marketing process.
References: Kotler et al. (2022), Ch. 1, p. 31.

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).question: ৯) A bank introduces green loans for eco-friendly projects, ensuring both profitability and environmental sustainability. This is an example of:
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).exp:
Balancing profit, customer satisfaction, and environmental welfare fits the societal marketing concept.
References: Kotler et al. (2022), Ch. 1, p. 38.

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).question: ১০)  Which concept assumes customers must be persuaded to buy through aggressive selling?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).exp:
The selling concept focuses on sales volume through promotion, especially for unsought goods.
References: Kotler et al. (2022), Ch. 1, p. 37.

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).question: ১১) Which is an example of customer lifetime value (CLV) thinking?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).option1: Offering discounts to close today’s sale only
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).option2: Investing in loyalty programs to retain high-value clients
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).exp:
CLV emphasizes long-term profitability from customer relationships, not just short-term transactions.
References: Kotler et al. (2022), Ch. 1, p. 41.

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).question: ১২) Which is a key risk of the production concept in modern markets?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).exp:
Overemphasizing efficiency and cost can compromise quality and responsiveness to customer needs.
References: Kotler et al. (2022), Ch. 1, p. 35.

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).question: ১৩) In the marketing concept, the correct sequence is:
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).option2: Market → Customer needs → Integrated marketing → Profits via satisfaction
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).option4: Capacity → Efficiency → Low prices → Profit via scale
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).exp:
The marketing concept is an outside-in approach: it starts with the market, identifies customer needs, integrates the marketing mix to satisfy them, and achieves profits through satisfaction. Options A and D are inside-out (production/selling concepts), and C reflects product concept thinking.
References: Kotler et al. (2022), Ch. 1, p. 37

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).question: ১৪) Which is a limitation of the product concept?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).option2: Overemphasis on quality and features while ignoring customer needs
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).exp:
The product concept assumes customers will choose products with the best quality/features, which risks “marketing myopia” if the features don’t match what customers value most.
References: Kotler et al. (2022)

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).question: ১৫) A company launching a healthier but more expensive biscuit without researching price sensitivity is likely falling into:
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).exp:
This is a classic example of over-focusing on product quality (health benefits) while ignoring customer affordability and demand research.
References: Kotler et al. (2022), Ch. 1, pp. 36–37.

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).question: ১৬) Which core marketing concept emphasizes “what customers will give up to get the product”?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).exp:
Explanation: Exchange is the act of obtaining a desired object from someone by offering something in return (often money, time, or effort). Needs and value are related but are not the transactional act itself.
References: Kotler et al. (2022)

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).question: ১৭) Which orientation fits best: “We focus on retaining profitable customers and growing share of wallet through CRM”?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).exp:
The customer/market concept extends the marketing concept by emphasizing not just satisfaction but maximizing the value of each customer relationship over time.
References: Kotler et al. (2022), Ch. 1, p. 40.

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).question: ১৮) Which orientation is MOST suitable for a monopolistic utility provider in Bangladesh (e.g., electricity)?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).exp:
With little competition and guaranteed demand, focus is typically on efficiency, cost control, and availability — hallmarks of the production concept.
References: Kotler et al. (2022), Ch. 1, p. 35.

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).question: ১৯)  “Delivering value to customers in ways that maintain or improve both the customer’s and society’s well-being” refers to:
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).exp:
This is the textbook definition of societal marketing — balancing company profits, consumer wants, and societal interests.
References: Kotler et al. (2022), Ch. 1, p. 38.

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).question: ২০) Which is NOT an element of Kotler’s core marketing concepts?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).exp:
Factory efficiency is part of production management, not a core marketing concept.
References: Kotler et al. (2022), Ch. 1, pp. 32–33.

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).question: ২১) A high-end electronics store focuses only on customers with above-average income and invests in premium experiences. This is an example of:
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).exp:
This reflects the customer concept applied to a specific high-value segment, aiming to maximize profitability from them.
References: Kotler et al. (2022), Ch. 1, p. 40.

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).question: ২২) Which approach is MOST vulnerable to competition in an era of rapid technological change?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).exp:
Product-oriented firms may invest heavily in features that are quickly outdated, missing shifts in customer needs.
References: Kotler et al. (2022), Ch. 1, p. 36.

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).question: ২৩) A company states: “We aim to increase customer satisfaction, but if customers want harmful products, we will not provide them.” This reflects:
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).exp:
Societal marketing applies an ethical filter to the marketing concept to protect long-term societal welfare.
References: Kotler et al. (2022), Ch. 1, p. 38.

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).question: ২৪) Which core concept reflects the benefit a customer gets minus the cost to obtain it?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).exp:
Perceived value = total benefits – total costs. Satisfaction measures how well performance matches expectations, and exchange is the act of trade.
References: Kotler et al. (2022), Ch. 1, p. 33.

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).question: ২৫) Which is the correct link between needs, wants, and demands?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).option1: Needs are shaped by culture; wants are basic human requirements
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).option2: Needs are basic; wants are culture-shaped; demands are wants with buying power
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).option3: Needs are created by marketing; wants are innate
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).exp:
This is the standard hierarchy: basic needs → shaped into wants → become demands when backed by ability to pay.
References: Kotler et al. (2022), Ch. 1, p. 32.

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).question: ২৬) Which orientation would prioritize building long-term trust even at the cost of short-term sales?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).exp:
The customer concept emphasizes lifetime value, loyalty, and trust, over short-term volume.
References: Kotler et al. (2022), Ch. 1, p. 40.

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).question: ২৭) “We must persuade customers to buy our product through aggressive promotion; otherwise, they won’t.” This is:
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).exp:
The selling concept is built on heavy promotion and sales tactics, especially for unsought goods.
References: Kotler et al. (2022), Ch. 1, p. 37.

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).question: ২৮) A Bangladeshi dairy brand adopts eco-friendly packaging because consumers are increasingly concerned about sustainability. This reflects:
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).exp:
This aligns with the societal marketing principle of balancing consumer satisfaction and environmental concerns.
References: Kotler et al. (2022), Ch. 1, p. 38.

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).question: ২৯) Which marketing orientation is MOST likely to invest in advanced data analytics for customer behavior tracking?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).exp:
Customer concept firms seek to understand and personalize offerings using detailed data to maximize CLV.
References: Kotler et al. (2022), Ch. 1, p. 40.

৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).question: ৩০) Which of the following concepts emphasizes profits through customer satisfaction as the primary goal?
৪৯তম বিসিএস ⎯ মার্কেটিং (৭২১).exp:
The marketing concept achieves profits by delivering superior customer satisfaction, unlike selling (focus on volume) or production (focus on efficiency).
References: Kotler et al. (2022), Ch. 1, p. 37.
